classes.title: ABSOLUTE CINEMA
classes.subtitle: Martin Scorsese - Both hands raised open at head height
classes.hint: Raise both hands open near head/shoulder height with elbows bent

classes.title: THINKING (ROLL SAFE)
classes.subtitle: Kayode Ewumi - Finger tapping temple, other arm relaxed
classes.hint: Touch your temple/forehead with one hand while keeping the other arm down

classes.title: LEO POINTING
classes.subtitle: Leonardo DiCaprio - Pointing at the screen, hand on chest
classes.hint: Extend one arm straight out to the side and hold the other hand near your chest

classes.title: DRAKE REJECT
classes.subtitle: Hotline Bling - Both hands raised sideways blocking/rejecting
classes.hint: Sweep both hands together to one side at shoulder height

classes.title: ARMS CROSSED (X)
classes.subtitle: Wakanda Forever - Both forearms crossed in an X over chest
classes.hint: Cross both wrists over your opposite shoulders across your chest

classes.title: SHOCKED / HANDS ON HEAD
classes.subtitle: Surprised Guy - Both hands placed high on crown/sides of head
classes.hint: Place both hands directly on top/sides of your head with elbows flared out

classes.title: T-POSE DOMINANCE
classes.subtitle: Assert Dominance - Both arms stretched straight horizontally
classes.hint: Extend both arms straight out horizontally at shoulder level

classes.title: CHILL / NEUTRAL
classes.subtitle: Just a Chill Guy - Relaxed idle pose with arms resting down
classes.hint: Relax both arms down at your sides
